NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Wɔde wo beaeɛ bu Nyamefrɛ mmerɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ma baabi a wowɔ. Wo beaeɛ tena wo afidie so.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Wɔde wo beaeɛ bu Nyamefrɛ mmerɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ma baabi a wowɔ na, sɛ “Mewɔ masjid” abue a, ɛde bue Nyamefrɛ tebea sɛ wokɔ masjid mu a. Wo beaeɛ tena wo afidie so.
NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Wɔde wo beaeɛ yɛ Nyamefrɛ mmerɛ foforo ankasa sɛ wosesa kuropɔn a na, sɛ “Mewɔ masjid” abue a, ɛde bue Nyamefrɛ tebea sɛ wokɔ masjid mu a. Wo beaeɛ tena wo afidie so.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Wɔde wo kamera kyerɛ Qibla fam wɔ kamera nhwɛ so na wɔde hwɛ nkitahodie kood a ɛwɔ wo TV so. Wɔnsie mfoni no na ɛmfiri wo afidie so da.
NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Wɔde kalenda kwan de Nyamefrɛ mmerɛ ka wo kalenda ho na, sɛ wobue a, wɔhwɛ sɛ dwumadie a ɛwɔ wo kalenda mu ne Nyamefrɛ berɛ hyia anaa. Wo kalenda nsɛm tena wo afidie so.
NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Wɔde kalenda kwan de Nyamefrɛ mmerɛ ka wo kalenda ho na, sɛ wobue a, wɔhwɛ sɛ dwumadie a ɛwɔ wo kalenda mu ne Nyamefrɛ berɛ hyia anaa. Wo kalenda nsɛm tena wo afidie so.
NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: App no bɔ TV a ɛwɔ wo ntam nkitahodie so mu de wo Nyamefrɛ mmerɛ ne Nyamefrɛ a woakyerɛ kɔ so. Wɔahintaw nsɛm no na ɛkɔ afidie mmienu no ntam nko ara.
NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: Nkaeɛ anammɔn a wopaw “Alaam ankasa” no, wɔhyɛ no sɛ alaam, sɛdeɛ wobɛte ɛmpo sɛ wo fon yɛ komm anaa Focus abue a.
